elevenlabsPrompt:
[intrigued] There's a hidden menu that makes your Android feel faster.

[confident] Here's the fix. Cut the animations in half.

[friendly] In About phone, tap Build number seven times. Open System, then Developer options. Set all three animation scales to half.

[delighted] Same phone, and every swipe feels twice as quick.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
